name: Kobold Festival
source:
You are a young kobold discovering yourself and the city around you. Explore the underground mining city of Mandl to meet and learn about friends both old and new. Uncover mysteries and fall in love, or not during your journey in the city of kobolds.

[From [url=https://mousecat.itch.io/kobold-festival]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一名年轻的狗头人，正逐渐认识自己与身边的城市。探索地下矿业城市Mandl，结识新朋友，加深对老朋友的了解。在这座狗头人城市的旅途中，揭开谜团，坠入爱河——或者不谈恋爱。

[摘自[url=https://mousecat.itch.io/kobold-festival]Itch.io[/url]]
